top.title: IETF 126 Highlights
top.summary: The IETF 126 meeting was held 18–24 July 2026 at the Hilton Vienna Park in Vienna, Austria, and online, hosted by Cisco. The week included the IETF Hackathon and Code Sprint, the New Participants' Program, five Birds-of-a-Feather (BoF) sessions, and more than 100 working group and research group sessions. The Applied Network Research Workshop also took place during the IETF 126 meeting week.

top.title: Post-Quantum Authentication: Up Next
top.summary: Post-quantum key establishment has moved from standards into deployment. Post-quantum authentication has not moved nearly as far, and specification work is no longer the only constraint. The IAB is holding a workshop in Prague on 11 and 12 October 2026 to bring deployment experience together with the people working on the relevant protocols and standards.

top.title: CVE-2026-119977 — WordPress WordPress Core Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability
top.summary: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.

top.title: CVE-2026-118527 — Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
top.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

top.title: CVE-2026-111357 — Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
top.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

top.title: CVE-2026-97229 — GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
top.summary: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

top.title: CVE-2026-76418 — Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
top.summary: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

top.title: CVE-2026-41709 — Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
top.summary: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

top.title: CVE-2026-46300 — Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
top.summary: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

top.title: CVE-2026-48356 — Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
top.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

top.title: CVE-2026-111497 — Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
top.summary: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

top.title: CVE-2026-109618 — PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
top.summary: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

top.title: New OpenSSF Tech Talk: How Upstream Contribution Minimizes Technical Debt & Streamlines CRA Reporting

Beyond the accumulating technical debt and security risks, passive open source consumption is no longer sustainable under emerging regulatory frameworks like the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), which imposes strict security and vulnerability management mandates.

If you maintain or develop software, it is critical to find and fix vulnerabilities before attackers exploit them.
